mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a colony in which the number of cells is fixed at the time of formation."
Coenobium is a colony in which the number of cells is fixed at the time of formation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process in which a cell flows around particles in its surroundings and takes them into the cytoplasm."
Phagocytosis is the process in which a cell flows around particles in its surroundings and takes them into the cytoplasm.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a thick-walled, nonmotile reproductive cell found in algae."
Akinete are a thick-walled, nonmotile reproductive cell found in algae.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for the formation of chalk beds on the bottom of the sea."
Marine coccolithophorides are responsible for the formation of chalk beds on the bottom of the sea.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a club-shaped structure with one or two nuclei to begin with."
The antheridium is a club-shaped structure with one or two nuclei to begin with.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the simplest type of sexual reproduction, where the fusing gametes are morphologically similar e.g."
Isogamy is the simplest type of sexual reproduction, where the fusing gametes are morphologically similar e.g.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are termed as gametophytic and sporophytic generations."
The two generations are termed as gametophytic and sporophytic generations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a brown algal seaweed common on the rocky coasts of the sea in temperate countries (Fig. 1.6b)."
Fucus is a brown algal seaweed common on the rocky coasts of the sea in temperate countries (Fig. 1.6b).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an indefinte body formed in Daldinia."
Stroma is an indefinte body formed in Daldinia.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of a central row of cells - central siphon, surrounded by vertical rows of cells, 4 to 24 - pericentral siphons."
The mature plant body is made up of a central row of cells - central siphon, surrounded by vertical rows of cells, 4 to 24 - pericentral siphons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called leptoids, and they are connected through plasmodesmata."
The food- conducting tubes are called leptoids, and they are connected through plasmodesmata.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known to attract sperms (Fig. 4.6 A and B) by secreting a gamone."
The eggs of Fucus are known to attract sperms (Fig. 4.6 A and B) by secreting a gamone.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very common alga found on rocky coasts of the sea (Fig. 1.6a)."
Ulva is a very common alga found on rocky coasts of the sea (Fig. 1.6a).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the dominant phase in Pteridophyte."
Gametophyte is the dominant phase in Pteridophyte.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the female and the donor is the male."
The recipient is the female and the donor is the male.
